ideas.title: FBI's Takeover of Minnesota ICE Shooting Investigation Raises Concerns
ideas.description: Investigate the circumstances surrounding the FBI's takeover of the investigation and the exclusion of Minnesota authorities.
ideas.angle: The potential lack of transparency and accountability in the investigation
questions: What were the reasons for the FBI's takeover?
How will this affect the investigation?
ideas.insight: The story should examine the potential implications of the FBI's takeover on the investigation and the concerns raised by local officials.
